observations: Black hair dryer hood mounted on a black metal stand with a four-legged base and wheels.
The stand has a height adjustment lever and a power cord extending from the base.
The hood has a transparent front panel and a control knob on top.
The stand is positioned in a room with pink walls, a brown couch, and a wooden shelf with beauty products and mannequin heads.
No brand or model name is visible on the hood or stand in either photo.
The hood appears to be in good condition with no visible damage or wear.

claims.claim: Brand new dryer, bought two for my wife use, but she's only making only one. Haven't be used
claims.evidence: Photos show no signs of use, but no proof of newness (e.g., packaging, tags, or serial number). The claim of 'bought two' is not verifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: The dryer may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the dryer turning on and blowing air, or a close-up of the internal components and power cord condition.

risks.risk: The stand may be unstable or have wobbling, especially with wheels.
risks.proof: A video showing the stand being moved or tilted to test stability.

risks.risk: The hood may have hidden damage or defects not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the hood's interior and all edges, including the transparent panel.

proof_requests: Video of the dryer in operation, showing it turning on and blowing air.
Close-up photo of the interior of the hood and all edges.
Video showing the stand being moved or tilted to test stability.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
